business_summary: CION Investment Corporation is a business development company. It specializes in investments in private credit investments, senior secured loans, including unitranche loans, First Lien, second lien loans, long-term subordinated loans, floating rate investments, collateralized securities, structured products, unsecured debt and mezzanine loans; equity interests such as warrants or options; and corporate bonds; and other debt securities in middle-market companies. The firm invests in private equity, growth capital, acquisitions, leveraged buyouts, market/product expansion, refinancing and recapitalization investments. The fund also invests up to 30 percent of their assets opportunistically in other types of investments, including the securities of larger public companies and foreign securities. It also makes investments in the secondary loan market. The fund does not invest in start-up companies, turnaround situations, or companies with speculative business plans. The fund prefers to invest in retail, construction & building, high tech industries, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, business services, media, chemicals, plastic, rubber, telecommunication, consumer services, advertising, printing and publishing, consumer goods, durables, diversified financials, and other industries. It also invests in homebuilding, restaurants, beverage and tobacco bars, broadcasting, distributors, electricity, durable and non-durable good distribution, food beverage and tobacco, energy, oil gas and consumables fuels, banking, finance, insurance, aerospace and defense, industrial machinery, paper and forest product machinery, information technology, metals and mining, and real estate. It primarily seeks to invest in the United States. The fund seeks to invest between $5 million and $50 million in companies with an EBITDA between $25 million and $75 million with average targeted hold of $30 million. It also purchases minority interests in the form of common or preferred equity in the target companies, typically in conjunction with its debt investments or through a co-investment with a financial sponsor. The fund takes majority stake. The fund seeks to exit its investments through an initial public offering of common stock, a merger, a sale, or other recapitalization.
business_summary_ko: CION Investment Corporation은 사업 개발 회사입니다. 이 회사는 민간 신용 투자, 유닛랜치 대출, 1차 담보, 2차 담보 대출, 장기 후순위 대출, 변동 금리 투자, 담보부 증권, 구조화 상품, 무담보 부채 및 메자닌 대출을 포함한 선순위 담보 대출에 대한 투자를 전문으로 합니다. 워런트나 옵션과 같은 지분; 회사채; 및 중견기업의 기타 채무증권. 이 회사는 사모 펀드, 성장 자본, 인수, 차입 매수, 시장/제품 확장, 재융자 및 자본 확충 투자에 투자합니다. 또한 이 펀드는 자산의 최대 30%를 대규모 상장 기업의 증권과 외국 증권을 포함한 다른 유형의 투자에 기회주의적으로 투자합니다. 2차 대출 시장에도 투자한다. 본 펀드는 신생기업, 턴어라운드 상황, 투기적인 사업계획을 갖고 있는 기업에는 투자하지 않습니다. 이 펀드는 소매, 건설 및 건축, 첨단 기술 산업, 의료, 제약, 비즈니스 서비스, 미디어, 화학, 플라스틱, 고무, 통신, 소비자 서비스, 광고, 인쇄 분야에 투자하는 것을 선호합니다.
